definition: yaml@2.8.3 for YAML; jsonc-parser@3.3.1 for strict JSON

anchorConvention.mappingObject: key start plus full source range
anchorConvention.arrayItem: item value/node start plus node range
anchorConvention.scalar: key start for property; item/node start otherwise
anchorConvention.recommendation: Store both a full range and a presentation anchor.

memory.methodology: process.memoryUsage().heapUsed delta around parse plus index; five post-warm-up samples; GC not forced
memory.limitation: Directional and may be zero because garbage collection and retained objects are not isolated.

resultHashScope: SHA-256 of compact JSON for all preceding result fields, excluding resultHash and resultHashScope.
